title: A failed firmware update
passage:
Man: Three demonstration units stopped responding after yesterday's firmware update. The older version still works on the spare unit.
Woman: Before we change anything, can you export the error logs? The software team needs them to reproduce the issue.
Man: Yes. Should I restore the earlier version afterward? We have a customer demonstration tomorrow morning.
Woman: Yes, once the logs are saved. Keep one failed unit unchanged for further investigation.
passageZh:
男：三台展示機在昨天更新韌體後停止回應。備用機上的舊版仍可正常運作。
女：在改動任何東西之前，你可以匯出錯誤紀錄嗎？軟體團隊需要它們來重現問題。
男：可以。之後我該恢復舊版嗎？明天早上有客戶展示。
女：要，等紀錄保存好之後再恢復。留一台故障機保持原狀，以便進一步調查。
